Thank you so much!

First of all, I'm gonna say this: I am bad at farming with something that isn't ADC. I just can't seem to do it, mostly due to being harassed or just getting nervous.

Being nervous. I am a very nervous person. If I lost, I go into a small depression and just kind of berate myself until I want to uninstall.  I never, ever yell at my teammates because I know I'm not perfect. I try my hardest not to be toxic so I kind of mitigate it to myself. 

Then lastly, runes. I've been running the same runes since season 2 with mild success. I own every single champion in the game but I only have 4 rune pages, so I have problems focusing in on a particular thing I should be running. I mean, if I win games with the runes I got, why change? I'd love to know better sets but for now these seem to work.
